name: Pipider
look: a super tiny spider wearing a big glossy seed on its back like a shell, with two big lime-ringed orange eyes, curly sprout feelers and eight tiny lime legs
entry: One of the smallest Pokémon there is: it fits on a fingertip. It hides under a seed it found and carries it everywhere like a shell, and when it is frightened it tucks its legs in and pretends to be an ordinary seed.
how: Wild: common in plains, grasslands and forests.
